text:
maria: Heads up — saw a customer report of double token charge when a canary routed to a lower-capacity model mid-stream. Repro steps attached.
aj: ugh. any logs?
maria: pasted logs:
```json
{ "session_id":"s-9834", "events": [{"type":"stream-start","model":"gptx-32b"},{"type":"model-swap","to":"gptx-8b","reason":"canary-rollout"},{"type":"toolcall","tool":"search","status":"truncated"},{"type":"stream-end"}] }
```
sophia: Looks like truncation happened after swap, toolcall got retried by client, and both fragments were billed. Is router dedupe off for midstream swaps?
kevin: router currently treats midstream model swap as a route change -> new session token. That can break our provision idempotency.
maria: billing-bot attached provisional_charge: 12 tokens x2 — provisional and confirmed differ.
billing-bot: automated message: provisional charges emitted for session s-9834: 24 tokens pending confirmation.
aj: can we detect toolcall mid-stream and tag for dedupe? maybe persist toolcall id across model swaps?
sophia: problem: toolcall tied to KV cache offset; after swap offsets reset. Options: carry tooling metadata across swap, or block model-swap mid-request unless compatible fallback.
kevin: blocking swap mid-request will hurt canary rollout velocity. prefer carrying metadata across swap.
maria: short-term mitigation: mark toolcall truncation retries as provisional and don't confirm until post-request reconcile with tracelet. Add console alert for high provisional->confirmed rate.
aj: agree. I'll open an RFC and assign owners.
sophia: can we add a dashboard panel showing provisional vs confirmed token delta per routing policy? Helps SRE.
maria: yes — devex, can you mock a waterfall view for provisional token flow? @devex
devex: noted — will mock a waterfall + per-route breakdown, and add a small notify for >1.5x provisional spike :chart_with_upwards_trend:.
maria: thanks. I'll schedule a 30m triage for tomorrow. :calendar:
